newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit steady as Malaysian mkt closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit steady as Malaysian mkt closed for holiday.

text.p: The ringgit was stuck in a tight range in thin overseas markets as Malaysia observed the Labour Day holiday on Thursday.
Banks in Malaysia would reopen on Friday, May 2.
At 0300 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5101/11 to a dollar against a closing of 2.5105 on Wednesday.
Dealers said there was hardly any activity in the market as players were unable to forecast the ringgit's trend when the market opens on Friday.
